page.layout: One page of text, with two round coin illustrations at the top, centred above the text. Running head at top centre. Single column of text, two paragraphs, no margin notes.

main_text.p: ABSIMARVS,qui & Tiberius tertius,ab exercitu Impe- rator eligitur,cum Leontius ingëti classe parata aduersus Ara- bas Africam occupantes,infecta re rediret,anno mundi 4661. à Christo nato 699. Hic Arabas,opera fratris,repressit. Philip- picum nobilitatis præcipuæ Chersonā relegauit, quòd aquila caput obumbrasse videbatur Philippico dormienti.Cæterùm se- ptimo post anno,reuerso tandem Iustiniano,qui pulsus fuerat, ab eóq; captus, vnà cum Leontio interimitur:calcato prius eo- rum collo,à Iustiniano in solio sedente,vniuersáque plebe cla- mante : Super aspidem & basilicum ambulasti,& leonem, draconém- que conculcasti. id etiā fecit Papa Friderico primo, vt infra dice- tur. Vide Ab. Vrsper.Egna.lib.2.Diac.lib.8.

PHILIPPICVS, cognomento Bardanes,quem acriter infectatus fuerat Iustinianus, quémque relegarat Absimarus, vita& imperio Iustinianum,secundò imperantem priuat,prius à se victum:ab exercitu etiā Iustiniani Imperator dicitur, anno mundi 4674. à Christo nato 712. Hic sextæ synodi decreta, altera synodo infirmare cōtendit,gratificaturus monacho, qui imperaturū illum prædixerat,id prædictionis præmium peten- ti. Huic cum sermonis multū, sapientiæ parum inesset,opésque imperij iampridem congestas dissiparet,passus etiam Bulgaros Thraciā depraedari,post annos ferè duos, ab Anastasio in ordi- nem redigitur,oculisq; pridie Pentecostes priuatur,& sequen- ti die Arthemius Imperator designatur. Vide Pau.Diaco.lib.8. Egna.lib.2.

page.notes: Two coin medallions at top: left, "IMP. TIBERIVS HISMARVS AV" with a radiate-crowned bust in profile; right, "IMP. PHILIPPICVS P.P. AVGVST" with a laureate bust in profile. The text "Absimarus" and "Iustinianum" retained as printed in the body; the coin legend reads HISMARVS as printed. Italic passage in the first paragraph is Latin verse from Psalm 91 as printed. Scan is slightly blurred; "Philippico" and "obumbrasse" read with some uncertainty but were clear enough to copy.
